workflowDecisions.decision: every tool produces a reviewed proposal or leased asset; only explicit finalization invokes authored-domain use cases

workflowDecisions.legacy: assistant tool calls and per-call JSON results are appended for the next provider iteration

scenarios.expected: provider failure retains the submitted message and its pre-turn draft revision
edit mode requires target kind and id and starts from a validated authored snapshot
character persona and lorebook turns cannot execute tools outside their declared capability set
undeclared calls fail exact admission instead of being replayed as an unknown-tool result
later proposal operations observe earlier successful operations from the same response
a typed error result is replayed and later admitted calls still execute
one creation turn performs at most eight provider iterations
preview transitions to awaiting review and cannot silently continue mutating in the same provider loop
requesting confirmation does not commit the target entity
explicit completion applies one validated proposal through target-domain use cases or reports a revision conflict
entry write edit delete and reorder calls modify only proposal state
destructive target operations require reviewed impact and explicit final apply
generation may produce a proposal asset but cancellation or rejection releases the unaccepted lease
active inference settles cancelled while the creation workflow remains resumable
a new attempt starts from the chosen prior proposal revision without deleting durable history
JSON or XML fallback calls obey the same exact declarations argument bounds and call limits as native calls
parse failure settles the attempt with a typed error instead of treating protocol text as a user reply
events carry ids stages operation names and safe summaries only
image generation edit and selection follow after proposal workflow and media lease ports exist
model prompt and authored-library queries plus destructive operations follow after permission and review policy
